messages:
nina: Quick sync — setting up a short roundtable tomorrow 10am PT to run through partner lab feedback. want to lock agenda: NDA data handoff, benchmark artifacts, SI integration blockers, and joint comms plan. who can make it?
omar: I can. need the raw perf logs from the lab so infra can triage regressions.
kelly: can do. i'll pull the latest benchmark csv and a short summary slide. do we have consent to share perf screenshots under the NDA? :thinking_face:
ben: Legal gave greenlight for aggregated numbers only, no raw logs outside the lab team. we should plan an action to produce an aggregated report.
tariq: noted. for SI integration: we hit a memory fragmentation issue on the xfer path — hw-ops already has a repro. lab's running a longer soak tonight.
hw-ops-bot: soak-run started on partner-01 at 2026-03-24T02:00Z, expected duration 12h. logs uploaded to s3://redwood-partner-lab/soak/1766123456/
omar: perfect, once soak finishes i'll grab the perf counters and run diff against baseline. i'll post a shaded table in the doc.
kelly: agenda suggestion: 1) aggregated perf summary 2) top 3 regressions + repro status 3) SI integration checklist 4) comms timeline & embargo window 5) action owners. ok?
ben: +1. add canary gating thresholds (p50/p95/p99) for the partner rollout.
tariq: for the SI checklist, need answers on kernel versions, nvlink settings, and whether partner wants our kernel patch applied. i'll bring the patch notes.
nina: thanks. last piece — marketplace listing: partner asked for a co-branded blurb and a tentative go-live date. we should avoid dates until lab passes soak + legal confirms NDA scope. propose tentative window w/in 2 weeks after soak pass.
omar: agree. i'll prepare a short abstract for the marketplace entry that is non-sensitive. share in thread for review.
kelly: i'll prepare the aggregated CSV -> slide deck and a one-page FAQ for partner-facing teams.
ben: i'll handle the embargo wording with legal and draft a short joint-announcement timeline.
announce-bot: Reminder: any joint announcement requires 72h review by comms + legal before publishing.
tariq: will the roundtable be recorded? partner asked to record for their internal team.
ben: legal prefers notes over recording for now. partner can get the notes and redacted slides.
nina: ok — final logistics: meeting 10:00 PT tomorrow, 30m. zoom link in calendar invite. please add any docs to the shared folder: https://redwood.work/partner-lab/1766123456 
omar: added preliminary perf diffs to the folder.
kelly: slides uploaded.
ina: thanks team. action items: @omar pull raw counters for internal triage (no external sharing), @kelly produce aggregated slide + FAQ, @ben draft embargo + comms timeline, @tariq bring repro & kernel patch notes. see you tomorrow. :raised_hands:
